verdict_text:
NO

The cast pattern in the second `cast_` transform (and its preceding `assert count ... is: 48`) only matches `attention.query_key_value.weight`, `mlp.dense_h_to_4h.weight`, and `mlp.dense_4h_to_h.weight` — it omits `attention.dense.weight`. That means only 48 of the required 64 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16, per layer 3 instead of 4, leaving `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` in float32 instead of bfloat16. This violates Required Result clause 1 (cast exactly the 64 listed projection matrices to bfloat16) and would fail the mandated check "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16" — but the plan's own assert checks for 48, so it wrongly passes.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
